evidence: The official standalone Codex CLI received a managed workspace-write profile with the fixture workspace as a writable root.
The launcher ignored user configuration that normally selects the native-Windows sandbox backend.
The tool router rejected every attempted command even though the model-visible filesystem policy was writable.
corrective_action: Freeze the native-Windows unelevated sandbox backend explicitly while continuing to ignore unrelated user configuration, then retry as a new immutable attempt.
